summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.95/gal
summary.blurb: As of June 4, 2026, regular unleaded in Wisconsin averages $3.95 per gallon, according to GasBuddy. Statewide, prices are down 25¢ from a week ago, down 34¢ from a month ago, up 107¢ from a year ago, per AAA.
